_readme: In-store specials. These only appear on the /in-store-specials/ page and are written to be redeemed at the showroom. 'locations' is a list of site ids or ['all']. Set active:false to hide. Add per-store floor model clearouts here too.
pageIntro: These offers are only available when you visit the showroom. Show the claim code on your phone at the counter, or mention it when you call ahead.

specials.title: 2025 Jacuzzi J-400 Floor Model Clearance
specials.summary: Showroom floor models from the 2025 J-400 series, fully inspected and covered by the full Jacuzzi warranty. Limited to what each showroom has on the floor.
details: Includes delivery within our service area

specials.title: Book a Private Wet Test
specials.summary: Bring your swimsuit and try the seats, jets and lounger before you decide. We fill and heat a tub for you, no pressure and no charge.
details: Ask about same-day availability by phone

specials.title: J-275 Flash Sale: $14,695
specials.summary: The 6-seat Jacuzzi J-275 with lounger, 38 jets and CLEARRAY UV-C water care, from $14,695 while 2025 stock lasts. That is $7,300 off the regular price.
